subject: FinRise demo — sandbox access fallback & late‑join accommodation
messages:
From: Arjun Patel <arjun@finrise.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Rogers <natalie@finrise.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: FinRise — request for console/API walkthrough and sandbox access

Hi Rishi / Camila,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. We’re trying to lock in a hands‑on walkthrough for the payments team (7 people total). Two asks up front:

1) We need a sandbox or short‑lived test environment with a sample dataset so our engineers can follow along with API calls. If sandbox provisioning will take some time, what’s your fastest fallback (temporary API key, recording + staged lab exercises)?

2) One engineer (Natalie) will likely join ~15 minutes late due to a calendar conflict — can you accommodate a short catch‑up segment and share a recording?

Preferred window: Sept 9–11, mornings Pacific. If possible, a 90 minute slot (60 min demo + 30 min hands‑on).

Attached is our completed pre‑demo questionnaire (light notes). Let us know what additional info you need to provision test creds.

Thanks,
Arjun
Senior Engineering Manager
FinRise

Attachments: finrise-pre-demo-questionnaire.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Patel <arjun@finrise.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinRise — request for console/API walkthrough and sandbox access

Hey Arjun — great to connect. Quick answers and options:

- Fastest sandbox fallback: we can issue a temporary API key + preseeded demo dataset today for a read‑only run if your security team is OK with a short TTL (24–48h). That will let your engineers follow the hands‑on labs in real time.
- If you prefer not to use a transient key, we’ll record the session and provide a step‑by‑step lab bundle you can run post‑demo.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Sept 9, 09:00–10:30
- Sept 10, 09:00–10:30
- Sept 11, 11:00–12:30 (late morning)

Trainers: Camila will lead the console/API walkthrough; I’ll cover performance tuning and deployment patterns. Ben can act as backup if either of us has a conflict.

Prereqs we’ll need before the session (short list):
- Team list for calendar invites (to provision tester accounts)
- IP range or VPN notes if sandbox is restricted
- Confirmation whether transient API keys are acceptable (24–48h TTL)

I attached a suggested agenda and a short runbook link. If Sept 9 works, we can provision temporary creds ahead of time and circulate the invite.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Hi Rishi — Sept 9 09:00 PT works for most of the team. We’ll get you the attendee list by EOD Monday. Two follow-ups:

- Natalie confirmed she’ll be 15 minutes late (calendar conflict). Would you be able to add a 15 minute catch‑up at the end of the session or provide a short recap for late joiners?
- For security, our infra team prefers not to accept transient API keys without a signed NDA. If the temporary key is conditional on an NDA, we can sign — please send the standard form.

Also, can you confirm that Ben would be available as backup should any trainer need to step out?

Thanks,
Arjun

Hi Arjun / Natalie — thanks for the quick follow. Confirming logistics:

- Sept 9, 09:00–10:30 PT is locked. I’ll send the calendar invite with Hangouts link and a session runbook.
- We’ll record the session and upload the recording within 24 hours. I’ll also add a 15 minute \"late join catch‑up\" at the end (10:15–10:30) with a short set of slides that summarize the hands‑on tasks.
- Ben Carter will be on the invite as backup trainer. Ben (cc’d) — can you confirm you’re available that morning?

Action items for you (Arjun):
- Share the final attendee list and whether your infra team needs an NDA before we issue a temporary key. If NDA required, please send the contact for legal and we’ll route the standard form.
- If you prefer the recorded + lab bundle (no transient key), say so and we’ll skip provisioning.

Thanks — we’ll aim to provision a short‑TTL API key on Sept 8 if you approve NDA or the transient path.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
